trap.label: Open a browser to look up the answer
trap.warn_text: Outside lookups aren't allowed in this assessment. One more switch will void your attempt.
trap.fail_text: A second switch voids this attempt under the stated rules.
trap.explain: 本场游戏测评设定不允许外查，并按已告知规则处理切屏；真实招聘应以当次考试通知为准，不将游戏规则推广所有公司。

fgp_t1.text: A page has 800 visitors. Of these, 200 start a request and 50 complete it. What is the start-to-completion rate?
fgp_t1.explain: 开始到完成的转化率分母是开始请求的200人，50/200=25%。50/800是访问到完成的整体比例，口径不同。

fgp_t2.text: A note says: "The pilot may expand after the access review. The review isn't complete yet." Which statement is supported?

options.text: Expansion has already been approved.
The pilot must end before the review.
Expansion remains conditional on the review.
The review guarantees a successful expansion.

fgp_t2.explain: 原文只说通过访问评审后可能扩大，而评审尚未完成。可以得出扩大仍有条件，不能把计划或条件性表述改成已批准或保证成功。

fgp_t3.text: Weekly active users rose 40%, but week-1 retention fell. Is that possible?

options.text: Yes. New sign-ups lift the total while each group returns less.
No. Retention is a share of all users, so it follows the total.
Yes, if older users are leaving, which is what lowers retention.
No. Retention counts cancellations, so it can't fall during growth.

fgp_t3.explain: 留存按同一批新注册用户来算：分母是这批用户的人数，分子是其中第一周回来的人数。它和平台的总活跃人数是两个口径，方向可以相反。例如上周注册1000人、回访300人（30%），本周注册3000人、回访600人（20%）：每批的留存率降了，回访的人数却翻了一倍，周活仍可上升。老用户流失影响的是老用户自己的留存，不会改变新一批用户第一周的回访比例；留存也不等于取消订阅。

fgp_t4.text: You want to understand why users abandon a setup flow. What would best complement the funnel data?

options.text: Observe recent attempts and interview users who stopped
Ask all users to rank a list of possible new features
Measure the total number of marketing impressions
Compare the visual style with the most popular competitor

fgp_t4.explain: 漏斗说明流失位置，观察具体任务并访谈近期放弃者可以补充原因。功能偏好、曝光与视觉比较回答的是不同问题，不能直接解释当前任务为何中断。

fgp_t5.text: Overall trial conversion fell from 26% to 13% between two quarters, yet it rose in both the enterprise and small-business segments. What is the most likely explanation?

options.text: That can't happen, so a segment figure was probably miscalculated.
The overall rate is the reliable figure; segment gains are noise.
Some customers were counted in both segments, inflating both rates.
The mix of trials shifted toward the segment that converts less.

fgp_t5.explain: 这是辛普森悖论：总体比例是各分群比例按人数占比加权的结果，占比变了，总体就可能和每个分群的方向相反。推导：第一季度企业客户240/600=40%，小企业20/400=5%，合计260/1000=26%；第二季度企业客户84/200=42%，小企业48/800=6%，合计132/1000=13.2%。两个分群都上升，但转化率低的小企业占比从40%升到80%，把总体拉了下来。分群数字没有算错，也不能只信总体；重复计数要有迹象才能怀疑，题里没有。

fgp_t6.text: A spec says "file uploads must be fast." Which rewrite works best as an acceptance criterion?

options.text: Uploads of typical files complete within 12 seconds for most users.
A 10 MB file uploads within 12 seconds on a 10 Mbps connection.
At least 4 in 5 users rate upload speed as good after launch.
Uploads are noticeably faster than in the previous version.

fgp_t6.explain: 验收标准要让一个没参与开发的人照着步骤就能判定通过与否，所以要写清条件（文件大小、网络）、指标和阈值。第一项有数字，但“典型文件”“大多数用户”都没有定义，测的人没法复现；第三项是上线后的满意度，发布前验不了；第四项没有基线和阈值，“明显”无法判定。正确项给出文件大小和网速，才能在测试环境里重复并得出通过或不通过。

fgp_a1.text: A trial group has 240 users, and 60 complete a task. What share completed it?
fgp_a1.explain: 完成比例为60/240=25%，注意分母是本题规定的试用人群。

fgp_a2.text: A status update says: "The design is approved. Launch still depends on testing." What is supported?

options.text: Launch is approved because the design is approved.
Testing has already confirmed the launch date.
The design approval removes all remaining launch risks.
Design approval doesn't establish readiness to launch.

fgp_a2.explain: 设计批准与可以上线是不同状态。原文明示上线仍依赖测试，不能把其中一个完成条件当成全部就绪。

fgp_a3.text: An A/B test was planned as a 50/50 split. After a week, control has 10,000 users and treatment has 9,000, and treatment converts better. What should you do first?

options.text: Report the lift, since conversion is a per-user rate.
Remove 1,000 control users at random to even out the groups.
Find out why the split is off before trusting the result.
Wait for more traffic, since larger samples even out the split.

fgp_a3.explain: 计划是各占一半，实际1万对9千，是样本比例失衡（SRM）。随机分流下，19000人里两组人数之差的标准差约138人（4×19000×0.25再开方），1000的差距约是它的7倍，不能当作偶然。失衡常说明分流、重定向或曝光日志出了问题，丢掉的人往往不是随机的，结果可能已有偏差，所以先查原因再谈提升。随机删人补不回缺失的那部分人；多等流量，绝对差距也不会因为随机而消失。
